evidence.title: Prime Data Centers Breaks Ground on Second Sacramento Data Center, Expanding Regional Campus Footprint
evidence.excerpt: Prime Data Centers reports that it broke ground on SMF02, the second data center on its Sacramento campus, and that the facility will deliver 18 MW of critical IT load capacity.
